claims.statement: On the ternary alphabet {-1,0,1}, phi^4=phi^2 pointwise, so m2 and lambda are not separately identifiable; (0,-1/2,1) is an exact parameter null direction.
The measured local Jacobians are stable under halving the declared finite-difference step within the verified tolerance.
Recursive retained-basis projection does not reproduce exact two-step push-forward followed by projection in the finite witness.

After one blocking step, the enriched field alphabet restores local 3D projected-coupling identifiability and yields one expanding, one near-unit, and one contracting finite-step eigenvalue magnitude.
A fixed-point equation is not well defined before a field-rescaling convention makes the projected RG map autonomous on common coordinates.
An autonomous rescaled finite RG map can separate robust local flow geometry from coordinate artifacts and support falsifiable approximate fixed-point searches.

metadata.purpose: Measure finite projected coupling-flow geometry while enforcing identifiability and coordinate-validity gates.
